contract: Compare SourceSeekPlanner and SourceCompositionLookup on regular movies. Both operate on media time without edit lists. The reference opens MOV with ignore_editlist=1 and +noparse+nofillin.

Plan arguments are plan, track ID, one-based target ordinal, preroll samples, window bytes and work quantum. The reference uses regular index entry i for sample i+1, finds the last key at or before the target and subtracts preroll from the key ordinal, clamped to one. It seeks with BACKWARD|ANY using the indexed start expressed in zero-based source ticks.

Compare every sample from decode start through the target inclusive with the selected stream's demuxed packets. Fold kind 1, position, size, DTS presence, signed DTS on the zero-based source clock and every byte. A negative first index DTS is the demux decode origin subtracted from packet DTS. Fold kind 7 at the completed range and kind 8 for a refusal.

Lookup arguments are lookup, track ID, window bytes, work quantum and one to 64 query ticks. Apply the contract selection to the reference packet PTS in decode order: latest at or before the query, with a tie reported and any unknown PTS taking precedence.

Fold kind 3, signed query ticks and one result per query. Result zero means before first, one gives the chosen ordinal, file position and signed PTS, two gives the first and second tied ordinals and signed PTS, and three gives the first unknown ordinal. Lookup uses reference packet clocks for parity only.
Input loading and argument parsing precede the observation window. Open, plan or lookup, read the requested payloads and release all operation state inside it.

open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 §§8.6.1.2.1–.3 and 8.7.3.2.2: the decode deltas count the samples whose extents the size table describes

open_deviations.reading: Codec-specific boxes carried inside a raw visual entry
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 §§4.2 and 8.5.2.1 and ETSI TS 102 114 V1.6.1 Annex E §E.2.2.2: ddts is part of a DTS audio sample entry; codec admission is distinct from reading the size, timing and chunk tables

open_deviations.reference: refuses the MOV open after diagnosing an unsupported DTS layout and a ddts overread inside that visual entry
open_deviations.compat: compat::mov::sample_entry SampleEntryHeaderProfile models codec configuration admission at open
